text:
Carry out your investigation!

Now that you know what settings you will input to the WaveRunner tile, it is time to run your investigation.

Instructions

1) Enter the Station, date and time range, and model selections in the WaveRunner tile.

2) Click "Run" in the bottom control bar.

3) When the model is finished running, click the Timeline It! button in the bottom control bar.

4) Answer the questions to interpret your data!
